To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MAC protocols are the most energy consuming part of a wireless sensor network.
the MAC protocols can be classified based on their characteristics into four categories, namely contention based protocols, schedule based protocols, hybrid protocols and energy efficient protocols.

the energy efficiency of the MAC protocol can be enhanced by reducing the number of collisions, reducing the energy consumption in idle state and by reducing the number and the duration of the control packets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of MAC protocols that are energy-efficient and robust.
the design and implementation of energy efficient MAC protocols for Wireless sensor networks.
the development of an efficient and robust MAC protocol to support the requirements of wireless sensor network applications.

the MAC protocols for Wireless sensor networks are still in the development stage, but there is a great potential to improve them in order to achieve the energy efficiency, which is a major issue in WSNs.
the MAC layer is a key factor to achieve energy efficiency in wireless sensor networks, and the design of energy efficient MAC protocols is a promising research area.
the proposed protocol has been designed to reduce the energy consumption of the sensor network.

the MAC protocol should not be considered as a stand-alone protocol but should be designed as a part of the overall network protocol stack.
